featured_reviews.name: Pratish Karkera
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a disappointing experience at Trends Footwear in Capital Mall. I purchased a Catwalk sandal for my wife. The MRP was ₹2,500, and after discount, I paid ₹2,200.

Firstly, the product they showed me was used by multiple customers, so I requested a fresh piece. They promised to deliver a new one, which already made the buying experience inconvenient.

Later, when I checked the same product on the official Catwalk website, it was available for around ₹1,700, which is significantly cheaper than what I paid. When I called the store to ask about this price difference, they simply said it was their website price and did not offer any proper explanation or adjustment.

Overall, the experience was not good. I also learned a lesson to always check online prices before purchasing from a physical store. I recommend other customers to compare prices and be careful before buying from this store.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Pratish Karkera,Thank you for rating us. We apologize for the inconvenience. We want to make this right. Please reach us at customerservice@ril.com or 1800 891 0001. 
Team Trends Footwear

featured_reviews.name: Yogita Karpe
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very Disappointing Experience – Poor Product Quality

I purchased a pair of Crocs worth ₹6,000 from Capital Mall (Metro Brand). Unfortunately, within just 6 months, the Crocs are completely damaged and not even in a wearable condition.

For a brand like Crocs, I expected durability and quality—especially at this price point. This kind of damage in such a short time is absolutely unacceptable.

When I approached the store for help, I was simply told that nothing can be done because it has been more than 6 months. There was no support, no solution, and no accountability for a clearly defective product.

If a customer is spending ₹6,000, is it unreasonable to expect the product to last longer than 6 months? How is this the customer’s fault?

Extremely disappointed with both product quality and after-sales service. I would strongly advise customers to think twice before purchasing from here.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Guest, we regret any inconvenience you experienced. Your feedback is valued and has been relayed to the relevant team. featured_reviews.name: Ranajit Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had a great experience shopping at Modern Shoes in Vasai East. The staff there were very competent and knowledgeable about their products, which helped me find the perfect pair of shoes for my needs. Additionally, the prices at Modern Shoes were very reasonable, which was a pleasant surprise given the quality of the shoes they carry.

I was impressed with the wide selection of shoes they had in stock, ranging from athletic shoes to dress shoes and everything in between. It was great to see so many options available in one place, which made my shopping experience easy and efficient.

Update as of Aug 9,2024: They have brought in bigger and better collection especially to suit rains and winter. I loved the new sneakers from Spark. New management, better behaved and well spoken. Overall, still highly recommended.

Overall, I highly recommend Modern Shoes for anyone in need of a new pair of shoes. Their competent staff, good prices, and extensive stock make for a top-notch shopping experience. If you're in the Vasai East area, be sure to check them out!
